Same floorplan/macros/pins. | prior: NEW hard top for d4g wbk_<q> x4 (ot_hbm_svc_wb_kport_q over ot_hbm_svc_wb_cutthrough_cdc #(NPC 16, QFOLD 1)); GEN0 bound the per-stack ot_hbm_svc_wb_kport as a SYNTH ETM.
